sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Month of April marks the beginning of the spring trophy fishing season throughout the United States.
sentences.zh: 四月标志着美国各地春季战利品垂钓季节的开始。

sentences.en: The warmer weather attracts a wide variety of deepwater fish to the shallows to spawn,
sentences.zh: 温暖的天气吸引了各种深水鱼类游向浅滩产卵，

sentences.en: and recreational anglers across the country flock to lakes, rivers, and beaches, hoping to reel in a valuable catch.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的休闲垂钓者纷纷涌向湖泊、河流和海滩，希望能钓到珍贵的渔获。

sentences.en: One such popular fishing spot is Chesapeake Bay in the country's east, a 200-mile long estuary that encompasses the states of Maryland and Virginia,
sentences.zh: 切萨皮克湾是美国东部一个热门的垂钓点，这是一个长达200英里的河口湾，横跨马里兰州和弗吉尼亚州，

sentences.en: eventually meeting with the Atlantic Ocean at its outlet.
sentences.zh: 最终在入海口与大西洋汇合。

sentences.en: The bay boasts a wide range of marine life, with delicacies like striped bass, crabs, and oysters among the most prized bounty.
sentences.zh: 海湾拥有丰富的海洋生物，条纹鲈鱼、螃蟹和牡蛎等美味是其中最珍贵的馈赠。

sentences.en: Trophy fishing season was well underway by May 5, 2004, yet that particular Wednesday presented a miserable morning for those casting a line into Chesapeake Bay.
sentences.zh: 到2004年5月5日，战利品垂钓季节正如火如荼，但对于那些在切萨皮克湾垂钓的人来说，那个周三却是一个糟糕的早晨。

sentences.en: Local hobby fishermen and long-time friends, Chris Henkel and Dee Connors, had taken to the water by boat, but the rough weather had forced them to drop anchor at Fisherman Island,
sentences.zh: 当地的业余渔民兼多年好友克里斯·亨克尔和迪·康纳斯乘船出海，但恶劣的天气迫使他们在渔人岛抛锚，

sentences.en: the meeting point between the bay and the ocean.
sentences.zh: 那里是海湾与大洋的交汇处。

sentences.en: The area was offering little apart from mudsharks and small fry, which was a disappointment, especially for Dee's two young children,
sentences.zh: 该区域除了泥鲨和小鱼外几乎一无所获，这令人非常失望，尤其是对于迪的两个年幼孩子来说，

sentences.en: Sam and Claire, who had come along for their inaugural fishing trip.
sentences.zh: 萨姆和克莱尔，他们是第一次参加钓鱼之旅。

sentences.en: By 10am, the rain and wind finally subsided, restoring calm to the waves and bringing a welcomed touch of sun.
sentences.zh: 上午10点，雨和风终于停了，海面恢复了平静，阳光也露出了久违的笑脸。

sentences.en: When the clouds finally parted, the men saw an opportunity to set sail for more fruitful waters, where they were guaranteed a better catch.
sentences.zh: 当云层散去，两人看到一个机会，决定启航前往更富饶的水域，那里保证会有更好的收获。

sentences.en: Stretching above and below their boat was the Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel, a 17.6 mile transit complex comprising of two bridges and two underwater tunnels.
sentences.zh: 在他们船只上方和下方延伸的是切萨皮克湾大桥隧道，这是一个全长17.6英里的交通枢纽，由两座桥梁和两条水下隧道组成。

sentences.en: It facilitated traffic between Virginia's detached coastline, allowing travellers a faster and more direct route from the mainland to adjoining states.
sentences.zh: 它便利了弗吉尼亚州离岸区域的交通，使旅客能从大陆更快、更直接地前往邻近各州。

sentences.en: A series of four artificial islands marked the points where the bridge dipped below the surface of the water, transforming into the tunnel, before re-emerging.
sentences.zh: 四座人工岛标志着大桥沉入水面转为隧道，随后又重新浮出水面的位置。

sentences.en: Chris and Dee directed their boat past the fourth island, where they caught sight of something floating in the water alongside their vessel.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和迪驾驶船只经过第四座岛屿时，看到船边有什么东西在水面上漂浮。

sentences.en: It was a dark green suitcase.
sentences.zh: 那是一个深绿色的手提箱。

sentences.en: Given its proximity to the bridge, the men assumed it must have blown off the luggage rack of a vehicle driving above and hauled it on board.
sentences.zh: 考虑到它离大桥很近，两人推测它一定是从上方行驶车辆的行李架上掉下来的，于是把它捞到了船上。

sentences.en: Twelve-year-old Sam expressed his excitement at thinking they had stumbled upon pirates' treasure
sentences.zh: 12岁的萨姆兴奋不已，以为他们意外发现了海盗的宝藏，

sentences.en: and hastily zipped the bag open, finding it held items racked in thick black garbage bags sealed with blue adhesive tape.
sentences.zh: 他急忙拉开拉链，发现里面装着被厚厚的黑色垃圾袋包裹的物品，并用蓝色胶带密封。

sentences.en: Before anyone could stop him, Sam tore open one of the bags and screamed in horror as he discovered what lay inside.
sentences.zh: 还没等别人阻止，萨姆撕开其中一个袋子，在发现里面的东西后惊恐地尖叫起来。

sentences.en: The garbage bags contained the pale legs of an adult human male severed at the knee joints.
sentences.zh: 垃圾袋里装着一名成年男性被从膝关节处截断的苍白双腿。

sentences.en: The suitcase didn't appear to have been in Chesapeake Bay for long.
sentences.zh: 这个手提箱看起来在切萨皮克湾里并没有待太久。

sentences.en: It featured the branding of American fashion house and designer Kenneth Cole, who sold a wide range of clothing, shoes, and accessories.
sentences.zh: 它带有美国时尚品牌肯尼斯·科尔的标志，该品牌销售各种服装、鞋履和配饰。

sentences.en: The medium-sized bag was a part of the casual and affordable Reaction collection and featured a retractable handle, wheels, and black detailing.
sentences.zh: 这个中号行李箱属于平价休闲的“Reaction”系列，配有伸缩拉杆、轮子和黑色装饰。

sentences.en: The following day, the local newspaper, The Virginian Pilot, ran a short three-sentence article on the grim discovery.
sentences.zh: 第二天，当地报纸《弗吉尼亚领航员报》刊登了一篇关于这一可怕发现的三句短文。

sentences.en: But the lack of details ensured it garnered little attention.
sentences.zh: 但由于缺乏细节，这篇报道几乎没有引起任何关注。

sentences.en: Many suspected the lack of media coverage was an intentional act to ensure the gruesome homicide would not impact visitor numbers to the famed Virginia Beach.
sentences.zh: 许多人怀疑媒体缺乏报道是有意为之，以确保这起骇人听闻的凶杀案不会影响著名的弗吉尼亚海滩的游客数量。

sentences.en: Six days later, at around midday on Monday May 10, a graduate student cleaning up litter on the shores of Fisherman Island's bird sanctuary
sentences.zh: 六天后，即5月10日周一中午左右，一名正在渔人岛鸟类保护区海岸清理垃圾的研究生，

sentences.en: spotted a large, dark green suitcase lying on the sand.
sentences.zh: 发现沙滩上躺着一个巨大的深绿色手提箱。

sentences.en: She ignored the item, only to notice it was still there when she returned to the shoreline the following day.
sentences.zh: 她起初没理会，但第二天回到岸边时发现它还在那里。

sentences.en: Giving in to her curiosity, she unzipped the bag and released the nauseating stench of rot from within.
sentences.zh: 出于好奇，她拉开了拉链，一股令人作呕的腐臭味从里面散发出来。

sentences.en: It contained an item wrapped in black garbage bags that upon closer inspection made the student recoil in horror.
sentences.zh: 里面装着一个用黑色垃圾袋包裹的物品，仔细一看，这名学生吓得连连后退。

sentences.en: Police arrived and immediately recognised the suitcase as a larger version of the one found days earlier that contained the severed legs.
sentences.zh: 警方赶到现场，立即认出这个手提箱是几天前发现装有断腿的那个箱子的加大版。

sentences.en: This one was in worse condition, having been beached in the hot sun for days, with the surf causing it to become severely waterlogged and filled with sand.
sentences.zh: 这个箱子状况更糟，在烈日下暴晒了几天，海浪冲刷导致它严重进水并灌满了沙子。

sentences.en: Two layers of garbage bags concealed a human torso, with the head and arms still attached.
sentences.zh: 两层垃圾袋包裹着一具男性躯干，头部和手臂仍然相连。

sentences.en: The victim was a Caucasian male aged between 30 and 40 with a muscular physique and short brown hair.
sentences.zh: 受害者是一名30至40岁的白人男性，体格健壮，留着棕色短发。

sentences.en: Several gunshot wounds were found throughout his body, with those in the skull and abdomen proving fatal.
sentences.zh: 尸体上有多处枪伤，其中头部和腹部的伤口是致命的。

sentences.en: X-ray imagery revealed two bullets still nestled in the victim's chest and waiSt.
sentences.zh: X光检查显示，受害者的胸部和腰部仍残留着两颗子弹。

sentences.en: One was covered in green fibres, having passed through fabric before penetrating the body.
sentences.zh: 其中一颗子弹上覆盖着绿色纤维，显然是穿透了织物后才射入体内的。

sentences.en: A blanket tucked behind the victim's head featured a tag that read,
sentences.zh: 塞在受害者头后的一条毯子上有一个标签，上面写着：

sentences.en: Property of HCSC.
sentences.zh: “HCSC财产”。

sentences.en: Initials for US-based healthcare organisation
sentences.zh: 这是美国一家医疗机构的首字母缩写，

sentences.en: Hospital Central Services Cooperative.
sentences.zh: 即“医院中央服务合作社”。

sentences.en: The organisation provided a variety of services, including an expansive laundry division that supplied linen to medical clinics across the country.
sentences.zh: 该机构提供多种服务，包括一个庞大的洗衣部门，为全国各地的医疗诊所提供布草。

sentences.en: A five and a half pound weight marked with the fitness brand name Weeda was stored in an outside pocket of the suitcase in a bid to weigh it down.
sentences.zh: 手提箱外侧口袋里装有一个重达五磅半、标有健身品牌“Weeda”的配重块，显然是为了增加箱子的重量。

sentences.en: Both recovered cases were part of a three-piece luggage set sold by Kenneth Cole.
sentences.zh: 两个被找回的箱子都属于肯尼斯·科尔销售的三件套行李箱系列。

sentences.en: The third and final case in the set, the smallest one typically used as carry-on luggage by passengers on long-haul flights, was still unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 该系列中第三个也是最后一个箱子，即通常由长途航班乘客用作随身行李的最小号箱子，至今下落不明。

sentences.en: The perpetrator's use of a firearm and the clinical dismemberment of the victim led Virginia police to theorise that the killing was a gangland-style hit.
sentences.zh: 凶手使用枪支并对受害者进行了专业的分尸，这使得弗吉尼亚警方推测这是一起黑帮式的谋杀。

sentences.en: As for identifying their John Doe, officers checked recent missing persons reports and turned their attention to the state's large military population,
sentences.zh: 至于确认这名“无名氏”的身份，警官们核查了近期的失踪人口报告，并将注意力转向了该州庞大的军人群体，

sentences.en: as his cropped haircut and muscular physique were akin to the conditions required for serving members of the armed forces.
sentences.zh: 因为他修剪整齐的短发和健壮的体格与武装部队现役军人的要求相符。

sentences.en: The suitcases were believed to have been discarded into Chesapeake Bay from the bridge above, but as the structure lacked security cameras, no such act was caught on film.
sentences.zh: 据信，这些手提箱是从上方的大桥被抛入切萨皮克湾的，但由于该结构缺乏监控摄像头，这一行为并未被拍下。

sentences.en: The midsection of the victim was still missing, from the belly button to the kneecaps, raising the collective concerns of police, media and locals
sentences.zh: 受害者的躯干中部，即从肚脐到膝盖的部分仍然缺失，这引起了警方、媒体和当地人的共同担忧，

sentences.en: that more body parts remained undiscovered within the bay.
sentences.zh: 担心海湾内还有更多尸块未被发现。

sentences.en: Six days later, on Sunday, May 16, the Virginia Beach Marine Patrol were alerted to the sighting of a small, green suitcase floating in the current
sentences.zh: 六天后，即5月16日周日，弗吉尼亚海滩海事巡逻队接到报告，称在水流中发现了一个绿色的小手提箱，

sentences.en: near the second artificial island of the Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel.
sentences.zh: 位置靠近切萨皮克湾大桥隧道的第二座人工岛。

sentences.en: In the worst condition of the lot, this suitcase was completely waterlogged and contained a black garbage bag covering the final piece of the unknown victim's body,
sentences.zh: 这是所有箱子中状况最差的一个，完全被水浸透，里面装有一个黑色垃圾袋，覆盖着受害者身体的最后一部分，

sentences.en: the abdomen and thighs, dressed in a purple pair of Fruit of the Loom brand briefs.
sentences.zh: 即腹部和大腿，穿着一条紫色的“Fruit of the Loom”品牌内裤。

sentences.en: His skull, nose and teeth were still intact, preserving the overall look of his face and facilitating the creation of a composite sketch,
sentences.zh: 他的头骨、鼻子和牙齿依然完好，保留了面部的整体特征，便于绘制合成素描，

sentences.en: which was featured throughout regional news reports.
sentences.zh: 该素描出现在了各地的电视新闻报道中。

sentences.en: The image caught the attention of local couple,
sentences.zh: 这张画像引起了一对当地夫妇的注意，

sentences.en: John and Susan Rice, who believed it looked like their close friend,
sentences.zh: 约翰和苏珊·赖斯，他们认为画像看起来很像他们的密友，

sentences.en: William Maguire, better known as Bill.
sentences.zh: 威廉·马奎尔，大家都叫他比尔。

sentences.en: The Rices arrived to the Virginia Beach Police Headquarters to view autopsy photos of the suitcase victim in an effort to confirm their identification.
sentences.zh: 赖斯夫妇来到弗吉尼亚海滩警察总部查看手提箱受害者的尸检照片，试图确认身份。

sentences.en: Sue was convinced it was Bill, but her husband was less certain, believing his best friend was alive, even though he hadn't heard from him in almost a month.
sentences.zh: 苏确信那就是比尔，但她的丈夫不太确定，他宁愿相信最好的朋友还活着，尽管他已经快一个月没收到比尔的消息了。

sentences.en: Police ran Bill Maguire's name through their database and found no record of the man having been reported missing.
sentences.zh: 警方在数据库中查询了比尔·马奎尔的名字，发现没有关于此人失踪的记录。

sentences.en: He did have a minor felony offence dating back to the early 80s for adopting aliases to write fraudulent checks.
sentences.zh: 他确实在80年代初有过轻微的重罪记录，当时他曾冒用他人身份开具欺诈支票。

sentences.en: Although he was never charged,
sentences.zh: 尽管他从未被起诉，

sentences.en: Bill's fingerprints had been kept on file, which detectives sent for comparison against the suitcase victim.
sentences.zh: 但比尔的指纹一直有存档，侦探们将其调出，与行李箱受害者的指纹进行了比对。

sentences.en: As they awaited the results of the fingerprint analysis, investigators dug further into Bill Maguire's history.
sentences.zh: 在等待指纹分析结果的同时，调查人员对比尔·马奎尔的过往进行了深入挖掘。

sentences.en: The 39-year-old lived in a rental apartment three states north in the New Jersey township of Woodbridge with his wife and two young sons.
sentences.zh: 这位39岁的男子与妻子及两个年幼的儿子住在三个州以北的新泽西州伍德布里奇镇的一间出租公寓里。

sentences.en: A Navy veteran,
sentences.zh: 作为一名海军退伍军人，

sentences.en: Bill was currently employed as an adjunct professor at the New Jersey Institute of Technology and was the co-owner of software consulting company
sentences.zh: 比尔目前在新泽西理工学院担任兼职教授，同时也是一家软件咨询公司的共同所有人，

sentences.en: J-Vista Software.
sentences.zh: 即J-Vista软件公司。

sentences.en: Weeks earlier, on Wednesday, April 28, he finalised the purchase of a two-storey colonial-style homestead in the rural New Jersey township of Asbury.
sentences.zh: 几周前的4月28日星期三，他刚完成了在新泽西州农村阿斯伯里镇一处殖民风格两层宅邸的购买手续。

sentences.en: Two days later, on Thursday, April 30, a domestic violence restraining order had been filed against him by his wife, Melanie.
sentences.zh: 两天后的4月30日星期四，他的妻子梅兰妮对他申请了一份家庭暴力限制令。

sentences.en: Bill and Melanie had met while working in the hospitality industry and quickly fell head over heels in love.
sentences.zh: 比尔和梅兰妮在酒店业工作时相识，并很快坠入爱河。

sentences.en: By 1997, the pair moved in together as they concentrated on their long-term career goals and by the end of the year, they were engaged.
sentences.zh: 到1997年，两人开始同居，专注于各自的长期职业目标，并在年底订了婚。

sentences.en: Melanie was already two months pregnant with their firstborn by the time their wedding took place in June 1999 and fell pregnant again two years later.
sentences.zh: 1999年6月他们举行婚礼时，梅兰妮已经怀上了他们的第一个孩子，两年后她又怀上了第二个。

sentences.en: Many reported the pair seemed a perfect and equal match, sharing a sharp and sarcastic wit they played off one another.
sentences.zh: 许多人说这对夫妻看起来是完美且势均力敌的一对，他们有着敏锐而讽刺的幽默感，总是互相打趣。

sentences.en: Bill was the mischievous practical joker who took immense pride in being a family man.
sentences.zh: 比尔是个爱搞恶作剧的人，并以身为一家之主而深感自豪。

sentences.en: Melanie, who was eight years his junior, was an intelligent and headstrong woman with a caring and compassionate side displayed through her work as a fertility nurse.
sentences.zh: 比他小八岁的梅兰妮是一位聪明且固执的女性，她作为生育护士的工作展现了她关怀和富有同情心的一面。

sentences.en: Yet, the Maguires' unsteady marriage seemed indicative of a near-decade-long relationship that had gone through its fair share of difficulties.
sentences.zh: 然而，马奎尔夫妇不稳定的婚姻似乎预示着这段近十年的关系已经历了不少困难。

sentences.en: The couple were not immune to squabbles and even fell foul of the law, with Bill caught driving with a suspended licence and Melanie later lying under oath to protect him.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇并非没有争吵，甚至还触犯过法律，比尔曾因驾照吊销期间开车被抓，而梅兰妮后来为了保护他而在宣誓后作伪证。

sentences.en: Police discovered the restraining order
sentences.zh: 警方发现那份限制令

sentences.en: Melanie had taken out against her husband had not yet been served, meaning Bill would not have been notified of it.
sentences.zh: 是梅兰妮针对她丈夫申请的，但尚未送达，这意味着比尔对此并不知情。

sentences.en: Furthermore, a court date had not been set to make it permanent.
sentences.zh: 此外，法院尚未确定将其转为永久限制令的日期。

sentences.en: Detectives contacted Melanie to inform her and she explained that Bill hadn't been in contact since he left their apartment three weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 侦探联系了梅兰妮告知此事，她解释说比尔自三周前离开公寓后就没再联系过。

sentences.en: She suspected he was having an affair and was convinced he was either in Atlantic City where he was known to frequent the casinos
sentences.zh: 她怀疑他有了外遇，并确信他要么在经常光顾赌场的大西洋城，

sentences.en: or Virginia Beach where he had always wanted to live.
sentences.zh: 要么在弗吉尼亚海滩，那是他一直想住的地方。

sentences.en: She had divorce papers ready, having filed the documentation with the state that described Bill as a volatile husband with a crippling gambling and drinking problem.
sentences.zh: 她已经准备好了离婚文件，并向州政府提交了材料，将比尔描述为一个反复无常的丈夫，且有严重的赌博和酗酒问题。

sentences.en: Melanie explained that his behaviour had recently become more erratic, with the desire to purchase a dream family home becoming an obsession
